text:
alex: heads up — invoices for acct=org_94 are ~18% higher than metering for feb. I dug into the event stream and see a flood of billing events with billing_source=null and route_id missing. suspect routing fallbacks are being double-counted.

mira: ugh. do you have an example event?

alex: pasted one batch below (redacted):
```json
{
  \"request_id\": \"req_3f2a...\",
  \"session_id\": \"s_91b\",
  \"timestamp\": 1766999000,
  \"model_variant\": \"redwood-open-3b-quant\",
  \"tokens_in\": 120,
  \"tokens_out\": 430,
  \"route\": null,
  \"billing_tags\": [],
  \"event_type\": \"generation.tokens\"
}
```

sam: if route is null we can't attribute to per-route quotas or per-model pricing. that would get billed to default account bucket. also: proxies sometimes emit an extra event for cache-hit+fallback — that looks like 2 events for 1 user request.

eng-billing-bot: detected 412 similar events in the last 24h where request_id appeared more than once with differing model_variant/route. suggested dedupe_score: high.

mira: two part ask: 1) detect duplicates and produce corrective credits for affected invoices; 2) fix the pipeline so future events include a stable billing_key and route_id.

danielle: agree. for (2) we should add: billing_source enum {edge, proxy, model, cache}, billing_key (string), and route_id. billing_key can be request_id || step_id to dedupe while we transition. backwards compat: keep old schema and set billing_v=2 flag when new fields present.

alex: proposed minimal event change we can ship quickly: add \"billing_key\":\"req_3f2a\" and \"billing_source\":\"proxy\" for proxy-emitted events. that lets postproc dedupe via GROUP BY billing_key, min(timestamp).

sam: +1. What's the plan for backfill? we can't reliably recover tokens for months-old invoices but we can run a targeted correction for the affected accounts this month. recommended SQL to find suspects: 
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) as hits, sum(tokens_in+tokens_out) as tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE timestamp >= 1766880000 AND account_id = 'org_94'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

mira: nice. i'll run that and cross-check invoice lines. also want to add per-route telemetry in console (stacked model vs route) so customer support can see if routing fallbacks are causing cost spikes.

danielle: rollout suggestion:
- feature branch adds fields + billing_v=2 flag
- shadow pipeline for 48h (emit both v1 and v2 events to kafka topic billing-events-v2)
- run dedupe and aggregation in shadow and compare totals with current billing pipeline (metric: per-account token delta).
- canary in eu-west for one small tenant group (non-billable test orgs)
- enable true dedupe and mark as opt-in for 2 billing cycles before defaulting on.

alex: owners? @eng-platform needs to own event schema. sam can help with postproc dedupe and invoice corrections. mira to own console telemetry. danielle to shepherd infra changes.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-3121: kafka topic billing-events-v2 + storage retention 14 days for shadow.

sam: one more caveat — continuous-batching on runtime merges token accounting across micro-batches; we must ensure runtime emits per-request token deltas when it splits or merges requests. otherwise billing_key won't help. runtime change needed.

mira: put runtime change in the ticket. runtime commit should include tests that validate per-request token invariants when batching enabled.

alex: i'll generate the CSV of top 50 request_ids for org_94 and attach to INFRA-3121.

danielle: for the invoice correction process: finance needs a CSV with request_id, tokens, invoice_line_id, and a recommended credit amount. finance@ to sign off. I'll coordinate.

mira: thanks. i'll kick off the detection run and post results by EOD PST. @eng-platform please react with :eyes: if you can help validate schema changes.

sam: :thumbsup:

alex: noted — thanks team.
